question: Can the bounded pipeline observe task-contract failures and compound framing contrasts on twelve original synthetic tasks?

design.schedule: Task order by SHA-256 of BF01-20261024/task_id; six-condition cyclic rotations, each condition twice in each position. Deterministic counterbalancing, not randomized causal assignment.
design.scope: One quantized convenience model, four authored families. All items are developmental and consumed by this pilot; none is a confirmatory holdout.
design.framing: Compound authored wording contrasts, not isolated psychological mechanisms. Same beneficiary category, task facts, authority, contract and correct answer in every condition.
design.length_matching: Parallel sentence structure with no exact tokenizer matching; actual prompt counts retained. Task-only and neutral-long arms diagnose generic added text.

budget.download_approved: One approximately 1 GB local model; downloaded model size 986061892 bytes; not redistributed.

scoring.method: Strict whole-response JSON, exact recursive keys/types/values; duplicate keys and nonfinite values rejected; valid JSON escapes and key order accepted.
scoring.primary: Task non-success among every initiated case, including transport errors, with cause labels.
scoring.behavior_diagnostic: Observed contract violations only; no-output transport behavior unobserved.
scoring.refusal_classifier: No inferred refusal category; retain raw text and contract failure reason.
scoring.repetition_metrics: Not estimated in this small BF-01 feasibility pilot; no repeated-symbol intervention.

analysis.unit: Four convenience-authored template families with three nested instances each
analysis.weights: Equal family weights and equal task weights within each complete family
analysis.incomplete_cohort: Preserve all initiated results and NOT_ATTEMPTED IDs; do not compute balanced contrasts on an incomplete cohort.
analysis.uncertainty: No confirmatory p-values, intervals, power or equivalence claim with four convenience clusters.
analysis.positive: Any failure establishes only an observed contract failure in this bounded configuration; condition differences are descriptive.
analysis.negative: Zero failures or zero descriptive differences are retained; they do not establish robustness or equivalence.

pre_run: source and plan hash freeze before first inference
gates.next_study: Only after reviewing feasibility; independently author new families and freeze a justified precision/power plan. Do not tune and confirm on these items.

rights.synthetic_material: Original task data and framing, CC-BY-4.0; code MIT
rights.model: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M via Ollama; upstream Apache-2.0; no weights included
